Ganpat University vs Silver Oak University for physiotherapy is a same-region private comparison. The recorded year fees are identical in our records, and neither side has a placement row on this page.

sections.heading: Ganpat University vs Silver Oak University for Bachelor of Physiotherapy: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: This page cannot name a placement winner, because neither university has a physiotherapy placement row in our records.
On recorded year fees the two sides are level, at ₹80,000. The decision has to come from official notices, campus visits and recognition details, not from a salary comparison here.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Ganpat University has a recorded year-wise total of ₹80,000 for the physiotherapy programme on this page. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total.

Silver Oak University has recorded tuition of ₹80,000 a year. The figures match in our database. Confirm both official circulars, including any clinical or examination charges that may sit outside this number.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither side has a placement row on this page. Do not assume a package that we do not hold.
Ask each university for its latest official physiotherapy placement or internship report, and compare the same graduating year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Gujarat physiotherapy admissions may follow state or university rules, sometimes through ACPC or Class 12 merit.
Read the current official admissions page of each university for eligibility, subjects and any counselling process.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Silver Oak University is in Ahmedabad. Ganpat University's main campus is at Kherva, in Mehsana district, though this comparison is listed against the Ahmedabad region.
Visit the actual teaching campus you will join. A same-region label on this page does not always mean the same daily commute.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On recorded year fees, there is nothing to choose: both show ₹80,000 in our records.
Because placements are missing, use official recognition, hospital tie-ups and the current fee circular to decide.
